description: Searching a total characteristic test returns \(n\) exactly when \(P(\bar x,n)\) holds and no earlier candidate satisfies \(P\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.predicateSearch_spec {k : ℕ}
  (P : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args (k + 1) → Prop)
  (x : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args k) (n : ℕ) :
  n ∈ Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.predicateSearch P x ↔
    P (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x n) ∧
      ∀ i < n, ¬P (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x i)
